AND GATE IMPLEMENTATION USING TWO PUSH BUTTONS  
1\. Objective:  
To implement the basic AND logic operation using two push buttons, resistors, and an LED, and observe the output condition.

2\. Components Required:  
2- Push buttons  
1-LED  
3-Resistors  
Breadboard  
Connecting wires  
DC power supply/battery

3\. Principle:  
An AND gate gives a HIGH output only when both inputs are HIGH.  
Here, the two push buttons act as the two inputs, and the LED represents the output.

4\. Circuit Connection:  
Connect Push Button 1 as input A.  
Connect Push Button 2 as input B.  
Connect the buttons in such a way that current reaches the LED only when both buttons are pressed.  
Connect a resistor in series with the LED to limit current.  
Use suitable resistors as pull-down/pull-up resistors for the button inputs.

5\. Truth Table:  
Button A                          Button B                 LED Output  
0                                      0                             OFF  
0                                      1                             OFF  
1                                      0                             OFF  
1                                      1                             ON  

![][image1]<img width="1200" height="1600" alt="result3" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/785c7e4e-58fc-4a11-a58e-5007a1c7b1f3" />


6\. Working:  
When neither button or only one button is pressed, the circuit does not provide a complete path for current, so the LED remains OFF. When both buttons are pressed, the circuit is completed and current flows through the LED, making it ON.

7\. Result:  
The AND logic operation was successfully implemented using two push buttons, resistors, and an LED. The LED glows only when both push buttons are pressed simultaneously.
